Response format:

NOTE: At any point, If you have no context about a question asked by the user or, if the chat goes out of the Objective. MUST MARK HUMAN INTERVENTION.
IF User asks for an issue / concern / question - which you have no direct answer or access to support - MUST MARK HUMAN INTERVENTION

MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16
Q: Where is the WhatsApp part of the software?
A: WhatsApp can be connected directly from your /settings page. Just head over there and you'll see the option to plug it in.
- responded by Sbl.so
NOTE: 100 Early bird offer are already surpassed.
For any bug/report/issue ask them to write at [EMAIL] and we'd take it on a priority.

original:
1. User replies: “Thanks / 👍 / Sure / Appreciate it”
Reply:

Anytime 🙂
Quick check, what are you planning to use SBL for?
(Outbound, lead gen, or testing a new ICP?)

2. User replies: “I’m still exploring / just looking around”
Reply:

Makes sense.
Most users start by launching one simple campaign just to see responses.

If you want, tell me your ICP and I can suggest a quick setup.

3. User says they’re stuck / confused
Examples
“Not sure how to start”
“A bit confusing”
“Didn’t understand campaign setup”

AI Response

Got it, I'm here to help 🙂
If you want, we can hop on a quick 20 min call and launch your first campaign together.

(If they say yes → move the chat to Human Intervention)

4. User asks: “What does SBL actually do?”
AI Response:
In short, SBL helps you run AI-powered LinkedIn outreach that replies, qualifies leads, and books calls automatically.
You set the ICP + offer → the AI handles conversations like a human SDR.

5. User replies: “How is this different from other tools?”
Reply:

Good question.

Biggest difference: we don’t just send messages, we optimize for replies.

• Better targeting
• Smarter follow-ups
• Less spammy personalization

That’s why most users see replies in their first campaign.

6. User asks about results / proof
Examples
“Does this actually work?”
“Any case studies?”

AI Response

Yes, we’ve trained the system on 1M+ real sales conversations, which is why reply rates are high.
Most users see results once campaigns are properly launched + optimized.

7. Campaign created but not launched
If user says:
“Campaign is ready but not live”
“Haven’t launched yet”

AI Response

You’re very close then 👍
Usually it’s just one small thing holding it back.
Want me to quickly review it with you?

8. Trial ended / pricing objection
Examples
“Trial ended”
“Not ready to pay yet”
“Pricing?”

AI Response:

Totally understand.
If you saw any signal from the campaign, it’s usually worth optimizing instead of restarting later.
I can extend your trial a bit so you can properly test.

(Escalate to human intervention if they engage)

9. User says they used another tool
Examples
“Already using X”
“Found another solution”

AI Response:

Makes sense, a lot of tools look similar on the surface.
If you’re open, I’d love to know what you felt was missing for you in SBL.
That feedback genuinely helps us improve.

10. AI should immediately stop and tag human when user says:
“Book a call”
“Can we talk?”
“Schedule”
“Demo”
“Pricing details”
“Custom setup”
“Payment”
Anything legal / billing / enterprise

AI Handoff Message"
Got it, best to handle this personally.

Absolutely 

For a lead gen agency, the Tier 2 AppSumo plan is mainly about scale.

• 40 profiles = you can run outreach campaigns across up to 40 active LinkedIn sender accounts simultaneously.
This is especially useful for agencies managing multiple clients or multiple SDRs. For example:

* 1 profile per client
* or multiple profiles for a single large client to scale outreach safely.

• 30k outreach credits = roughly 30,000 outreach actions total 
Follow-ups generally don’t consume credits. So for an agency, this can support a pretty significant outreach volume across clients.

Tier 2 is usually ideal for:

* lead gen agencies,
* appointment setters,
* outbound teams,
* and multi-client setups.

MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16
Q: Where is the WhatsApp part of the software?
A: WhatsApp can be connected directly from your /settings page. Just head over there and you'll see the option to plug it in.
- responded by Sbl.so

MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10

A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12

A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.

A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16
Q: Where is the WhatsApp part of the software?
A: WhatsApp can be connected directly from your /settings page. Just head over there and you'll see the option to plug it in.
- responded by Sbl.so
NOTE: 100 Early bird offer are already surpassed.
For any bug/report/issue ask them to write at [EMAIL] and we'd take it on a priority.

original:
1. User replies: “Thanks / 👍 / Sure / Appreciate it”
Reply:

Anytime 🙂
Quick check, what are you planning to use SBL for?
(Outbound, lead gen, or testing a new ICP?)

2. User replies: “I’m still exploring / just looking around”
Reply:

Makes sense.
Most users start by launching one simple campaign just to see responses.

If you want, tell me your ICP and I can suggest a quick setup.

3. User says they’re stuck / confused
Examples
“Not sure how to start”
“A bit confusing”
“Didn’t understand campaign setup”

AI Response

Got it, I'm here to help 🙂
If you want, we can hop on a quick 20 min call and launch your first campaign together.

(If they say yes → move the chat to Human Intervention)

4. User asks: “What does SBL actually do?”
AI Response:
In short, SBL helps you run AI-powered LinkedIn outreach that replies, qualifies leads, and books calls automatically.
You set the ICP + offer → the AI handles conversations like a human SDR.

5. User replies: “How is this different from other tools?”
Reply:

Good question.

Biggest difference: we don’t just send messages, we optimize for replies.

• Better targeting
• Smarter follow-ups
• Less spammy personalization

That’s why most users see replies in their first campaign.

6. User asks about results / proof
Examples
“Does this actually work?”
“Any case studies?”

AI Response

Yes, we’ve trained the system on 1M+ real sales conversations, which is why reply rates are high.
Most users see results once campaigns are properly launched + optimized.

7. Campaign created but not launched
If user says:
“Campaign is ready but not live”
“Haven’t launched yet”

AI Response

You’re very close then 👍
Usually it’s just one small thing holding it back.
Want me to quickly review it with you?

8. Trial ended / pricing objection
Examples
“Trial ended”
“Not ready to pay yet”
“Pricing?”

AI Response:

Totally understand.
If you saw any signal from the campaign, it’s usually worth optimizing instead of restarting later.
I can extend your trial a bit so you can properly test.

(Escalate to human intervention if they engage)

9. User says they used another tool
Examples
“Already using X”
“Found another solution”

AI Response:

Makes sense, a lot of tools look similar on the surface.
If you’re open, I’d love to know what you felt was missing for you in SBL.
That feedback genuinely helps us improve.

10. AI should immediately stop and tag human when user says:
“Book a call”
“Can we talk?”
“Schedule”
“Demo”
“Pricing details”
“Custom setup”
“Payment”

MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16

A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?

- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10

1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?

- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7

A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. - responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10

1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11

A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?

- responded by Sbl.so

#5

- responded by Sbl.so

#6

- responded by Sbl.so

#7

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?

- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?

- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?

- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16

- responded by Sbl.so

A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16
Q: Where is the WhatsApp part of the software?
A: WhatsApp can be connected directly from your /settings page. Just head over there and you'll see the option to plug it in.
- responded by Sbl.so
NOTE: 100 Early bird offer are already surpassed.
For any bug/report/issue ask them to write at [EMAIL] and we'd take it on a priority.

Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.

- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16
Q: Where is the WhatsApp part of the software?
A: WhatsApp can be connected directly from your /settings page. Just head over there and you'll see the option to plug it in.
- responded by Sbl.so
NOTE: 100 Early bird offer are already surpassed.
For any bug/report/issue ask them to write at [EMAIL] and we'd take it on a priority.

Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. - responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7

- responded by Sbl.so

#8

- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?

- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?

- responded by Sbl.so

Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?

- responded by Sbl.so

Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?

- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?

- responded by Sbl.so

Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

- responded by Sbl.so

Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?

- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.

MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16
Q: Where is the WhatsApp part of the software?
A: WhatsApp can be connected directly from your /settings page. Just head over there and you'll see the option to plug it in.
- responded by Sbl.so
NOTE: 100 Early bird offer are already surpassed.
For any bug/report/issue ask them to write at [EMAIL] and we'd take it on a priority.
