MOST ASKED QUESTIONS

#1
Q: How are credits used? Does every action consume a credit?
A: Credits are simple and fair. 1 NEW outreach equals 1 credit, and that's it. Replies, follow-ups, connection requests, AI conversations, and lead enrichment do not consume any extra credits. You're only charged when you reach a new prospect for the first time.
- responded by Sbl.so

#2
Q: Do I need Sales Navigator to use Sbl?
A: Not at all. You can generate leads directly from our Lead Agent by describing your ICP in plain English, or simply import a CSV. Sales Navigator is completely optional, never mandatory.
- responded by Sbl.so

#3
Q: How do I stop the AI from auto-replying once a prospect responds?
A: You can turn this off in seconds. Head to your Chat Flow settings and switch on the "Disable Conversations?" toggle. The AI will stop replying automatically, and the conversation will be flagged for your attention so you can take over personally.
- responded by Sbl.so

#4
Q: How many messages can I send per day from my LinkedIn account?
A: You can safely send up to 50 new outreach messages per day to new connections, and up to 200 messages per day to existing connections. If your profile has fewer than 1,000 connections, we'd recommend staying around 20 to 25 per day to keep your account fully safe and warmed up.
- responded by Sbl.so

#5
Q: What is the difference between Outreach Sequence and Smart Follow-up?
A: Great question, and they work beautifully together. The Outreach Sequence handles your first message and the follow-ups that go out if a prospect hasn't replied yet. Smart Follow-ups kick in when a prospect goes idle after some chat or engagement. Between the two, both your cold and warm scenarios are covered.
- responded by Sbl.so

#6
Q: Are follow-up messages the same for new connections and existing connections? Can I differentiate?
A: Yes, you have full flexibility on the opening message. The follow-up sequence runs the same for both, but you can set entirely different first messages for new connections vs existing connections. This way your first touchpoint feels right for the relationship you already have.
- responded by Sbl.so

#7
Q: How do the SDR / fractional profiles work, and what do they cost?
A: Our SDR profiles are real, verified human profiles that connect to your workspace. We optimize each one to match your brand tone, headline, and banner. Each profile sends roughly 800 connection requests per month, so 10 profiles gets you to 8,000 per month. Pricing is $69 per profile per month depending on volume, and setup takes about 24 hours. For 10 or more profiles, the pricing is $59 per profile per month. There is a 'Preferred location change' add-on for $15 per profile/month where you can specify the desired location of the SDRs.
- responded by Sbl.so

#8
Q: Are you using the official LinkedIn API? How safe is Sbl for my account?
A: We don't use the official LinkedIn API, and that's intentional. Sbl runs on a cloud-based session layer that mimics natural human behaviour, with realistic delays, safe daily volumes, and automatic account rotation. We've been running since 2023 with 100+ multi-million dollar global brands trusting us with their accounts and zero systemic bans.
- responded by Sbl.so

#9
Q: My LinkedIn account keeps disconnecting. How do I fix it?
A: This usually has a simple fix. Make sure your working hours, time zone, and location are set correctly inside Sbl. If you're using the Extension login, please switch to Credentials login instead. Extension cookies tend to expire frequently, and this is the most common reason behind repeated disconnects.
- responded by Sbl.so

#10
Q: Does Sbl support Italian, German, Spanish, French, and other languages?
A: Yes, Sbl is fully multilingual. To make sure your messages stay in your target language, set it in two places:
1. Campaign Objective (inside Chat Flow)
2. Persona, under Communication Style guide
Once that's done, all generated messages will stay perfectly in language.
- responded by Sbl.so

#11
Q: How do I export the leads I found?
A: Exporting is one click away. Look for the download icon, which is available both inside the Leads tab of your campaign and inside the Chats tab. You can pull a clean CSV anytime you need.
- responded by Sbl.so

#12
Q: How do I stop the system from sending outreach to people I'm already connected with?
A: You can control this through the ICP Filter. Just explicitly mention there to reach only New Connections and not 1st-degree connections. This will keep your existing network completely out of the campaign.
- responded by Sbl.so

#16

A: WhatsApp can be connected directly from your /settings page. Just head over there and you'll see the option to plug it in.
- responded by Sbl.so
